responsibility: Provides the NEON/VFP-specific scheduling model component for Cortex-A15. It classifies Arm SIMD and floating-point instructions into Cortex-A15-specific neon_type categories and assigns detailed reservations for arithmetic, multiply, permute, load/store, VFP, and crypto-related execution resources, complementing cortex-a15.md’s integer/core pipeline model with the SIMD/FPU side of the microarchitecture.
